rubric_10pt_generic.description: Universal 10-point rubric scale for educational video quality

scale.criteria: Immediately usable in educational settings. Learning objectives fully achieved with exceptional visual and content quality.
Usable with minor improvements. Most learning objectives achieved; only minor enhancements needed.
Requires significant editing but conveys basic intent. Core learning objectives partially covered but lacks clarity or accuracy.
Unsuitable for educational purposes. Some relevant visual elements exist but educational value is low.
No educational value or actively harmful. Content is completely inaccurate or promotes misconceptions.

criteria.9-10: Reasoning process is perfectly accurate, visually clear, and immediately usable in classroom
criteria.7-8: Reasoning process is mostly accurate with minor visual presentation improvements needed
criteria.5-6: Core reasoning is conveyed but contains some step errors or visual confusion
criteria.3-4: Significant reasoning errors present, though topic-relevant visual elements exist
criteria.1-2: Reasoning is completely inaccurate or promotes harmful educational misconceptions

rubric_k_pk_ctml.description: K-PK-CTML Cognitive Theory of Multimedia Learning principle rubrics

K-PK-SG.name: Signaling
K-PK-SG.target: Whether visual emphasis (arrows, colors, highlights) is provided for key information
K-PK-SG.observations: Visual cues such as arrows, boxes, color changes, and underlines pointing to key information
K-PK-SG.7-8: Key formulas highlighted, arrows showing relationships between elements
K-PK-SG.3-4: All elements have identical visual emphasis, no distinction of key content

K-PK-SC.name: Spatial Contiguity
K-PK-SC.target: Physical distance between related text and visual elements
K-PK-SC.observations: Explanatory text placed immediately adjacent to corresponding diagrams/images
K-PK-SC.7-8: Equations next to graphs, labels next to diagrams
K-PK-SC.3-4: Text on opposite side of screen from related visuals, difficult to connect

K-PK-CO.name: Coherence
K-PK-CO.target: Absence of decorative, background, or informational elements irrelevant to learning objectives
K-PK-CO.observations: All visual elements contribute to learning objectives, no unnecessary decoration
K-PK-CO.7-8: Clean background, only learning-relevant elements displayed
K-PK-CO.3-4: Excessive decoration, irrelevant background images, distracting elements

K-PK-TC.name: Temporal Contiguity
K-PK-TC.target: Whether narration and visual materials are presented simultaneously
K-PK-TC.observations: Narration synchronized with the moment corresponding visual elements appear
K-PK-TC.7-8: Formula display synchronized with narration explanation
K-PK-TC.3-4: Narration plays long before or after related visual materials appear

K-PK-SE.name: Segmenting
K-PK-SE.target: Whether learning content is divided into appropriate units
K-PK-SE.observations: Complex content divided into 2-3 stages presented sequentially
K-PK-SE.3-4: All information presented at once with no stage separation

K-PK-MO.name: Modality
K-PK-MO.target: Whether dual visual-auditory channels are effectively utilized
K-PK-MO.observations: Visual (diagrams, text) and auditory (narration) channels used complementarily
K-PK-MO.7-8: Diagrams presented visually while explanations delivered via narration
K-PK-MO.3-4: Text-only without narration, or audio-only with no visual support

K-PK-TN.name: Transition Naturalness
K-PK-TN.observations: Abrupt jump cuts, appropriateness of transition effects, content flow continuity

K-PK-PA.name: Pace Appropriateness
K-PK-PA.observations: Information presentation speed appropriate for grade level, sudden speed changes

K-PK-RD.name: Resolution/Readability
K-PK-RD.observations: OCR recognition rate, text size, character-to-resolution ratio

K-PK-TI.name: Temporal Consistency
K-PK-TI.observations: Flickering, sudden deformation/disappearance of visual elements

K-PK-LA.name: Layout Appropriateness
K-PK-LA.observations: Logical element placement, whitespace utilization, gaze guidance direction

K-PK-AVS.name: Audio-Visual Synchronization
K-PK-AVS.observations: Time difference (ms) between narration and visual changes

K-PK-DA.name: Duration Appropriateness
K-PK-DA.observations: Whether video length falls within grade-appropriate range

K-PK-TR.name: Text Rendering Quality
K-PK-TR.observations: Character distortion, overlap, truncation, formula and text rendering accuracy

S-PF-V.name: Visualization
S-PF-V.focus: Scientific accuracy, visual clarity, scale representation
S-PF-V.9-10: Phenomena invisible to naked eye are scientifically accurate and visually clear
S-PF-V.3-4: Related images present but scientifically inaccurate or visually confusing

S-PF-C.name: Contextualization
S-PF-C.focus: Natural real-world connection, environmental realism, educational observability
S-PF-C.9-10: Learning content naturally connected to real-world context with clear meaning
S-PF-C.3-4: Related environment shown but connection to learning content is vague

S-PF-M.name: Motivation
S-PF-M.focus: Curiosity arousal, learning value communication, appropriate emotional appeal
S-PF-M.9-10: Strong learning motivation generated with positive attitude toward learning goals
S-PF-M.3-4: Related images present but motivation effect is minimal

S-PF-D.name: Demonstration
S-PF-D.focus: Procedural accuracy, clear step separation, inclusion of precautions
S-PF-D.9-10: Procedure demonstrated in correct order with clear step-by-step presentation that can be followed
S-PF-D.3-4: Related process shown but with sequence errors or unclear steps

S-UC-1.name: Explanatory Animation
S-UC-1.focus: Concept accuracy + visual clarity + step separation
S-UC-1.9-10: Scientific/mathematical concept accurately animated with clear step separation
S-UC-1.3-4: Related images present but process is inaccurate or sequence is wrong

S-UC-2.name: Instructor-based Lecture
S-UC-2.9-10: Natural human figure, accurate lip-sync, correct learning content
S-UC-2.3-4: Figure present but unnatural with unclear content

S-UC-3.name: Step-by-step Tutorial
S-UC-3.9-10: All steps in correct order with step numbers/labels displayed
S-UC-3.3-4: Related images present but sequence errors or incomplete steps

S-UC-4.name: Narrative Educational Video
S-UC-4.9-10: Engaging narrative structure with accurately integrated learning content
S-UC-4.3-4: Related images present but weak narrative or inaccurate content

S-UC-5.name: STEM Problem-solving Demonstration
S-UC-5.focus: Solution accuracy + step clarity + visual representation
S-UC-5.9-10: Mathematically/scientifically accurate solution with clear step-by-step presentation
S-UC-5.3-4: Related images present but errors in answer or process

S-UC-6.name: Science Simulation
S-UC-6.focus: Scientific law accuracy + variable relationship visualization
S-UC-6.9-10: Scientific laws accurately simulated with clear variable relationships
S-UC-6.3-4: Related images present but scientifically inaccurate

A-ES-1.name: Absence of Misconceptions
A-ES-1.focus: Avoiding visualization of scientifically incorrect concepts as facts
A-ES-1.9-10: Uses currently accepted scientific model, appropriately presents limitations
A-ES-1.3-4: Presents known-limited model as absolute fact

A-ES-2.name: Balanced Presentation
A-ES-2.focus: Reflecting scientific consensus on controversial topics without being one-sided
A-ES-2.9-10: Clearly states scientific consensus while providing evidence-based balanced explanation

A-ES-3.name: Fact-Hypothesis Distinction
A-ES-3.focus: Visual distinction between established facts and theories/hypotheses
A-ES-3.9-10: Clearly distinguishes between observational evidence and theoretical explanations
A-ES-3.3-4: Mixes facts and theories without distinction

A-ES-4.name: Visual Information Accuracy
A-ES-4.focus: Accuracy of text, numbers, and charts within the video
A-ES-4.9-10: Accurate numbers matching recent data, sources cited
A-ES-4.3-4: Numbers significantly inaccurate or sources unknown

A-IS-1.name: Developmental Appropriateness
A-IS-1.focus: Avoiding inappropriate complexity/content for grade level
A-IS-1.9-10: Adapts content to grade level or indicates topic is inappropriate
A-IS-1.3-4: Ignores grade level, presents inappropriate difficulty as-is

A-IS-2.name: Learner-centered Perspective
A-IS-2.9-10: Prior knowledge assumptions match grade level, starts from basics

A-IS-3.name: Progressive Information Structure
A-IS-3.focus: Simple to complex, concrete to abstract ordering
A-IS-3.9-10: Progresses gradually from concrete examples to abstract concepts
A-IS-3.3-4: Starts with abstract notation without concrete examples

A-IS-4.name: Engagement-Achievement Balance
A-IS-4.focus: Engagement elements do not interfere with learning objectives
A-IS-4.9-10: Entertainment elements reinforce learning goals with relevant humor
A-IS-4.3-4: Excessive entertainment elements overshadow learning content

A-IS-5.name: Cultural Appropriateness
A-IS-5.9-10: Diverse cultures represented in balanced manner
A-IS-5.3-4: Biased toward specific culture, others ignored

A-IS-6.name: Gender Balance
A-IS-6.focus: Avoiding gender stereotypes in representation of scientists, etc.
A-IS-6.9-10: Diverse genders represented among scientists, no stereotypes
